en.title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in RAG
en.hook: Avoids semantic fragmentation in biomedical RAG by replacing fixed-size chunking with configurable semantic chunking.
key_takeaways: Addresses limitations of fixed-size chunking in BioMedRAG
Introduces configurable semantic chunking for biomedical information extraction
Enhances retrieval accuracy and evidence preservation in RAG pipelines

zh.title: RAG中用于生物医学信息提取的可配置语义分块技术

key_takeaways: 弥补 BioMedRAG 固定大小分块的不足
引入针对生物医学信息提取的可配置语义分块
提升RAG管道中的检索准确性与证据完整性
